title: Ship the Delete with the Feature: A Deletion-Readiness Checklist
content: Many teams can say how a new feature creates data. Fewer can say how that data will be deleted: where every copy lives, which service removes it, in what order, by when, at what load, and how anyone would check that it is gone. Answering those questions after release is expensive, because copies have already spread into indexes, caches, analytics stores, and backups. This article proposes a 12-item deletion-readiness checklist that a feature team and its platform team complete before release. It draws on a large messaging platform’s deletion system and on published studies of deletion failures. Each item names the failure it addresses and the red flags of a weak answer. A worked example shows good answers, and a release gate makes them a written, owned commitment.
